history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration enhance guidance and oversight on the formulation of the programme budget to ensure that all entities increase the disclosure of comprehensive analyses and breakdowns for the proposed grants and contributions in future budget proposals.
history.administration_response: The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget provided guidance to ensure that entities disclose details of the proposed grants and contributions, with a breakdown by component/subprogramme, and post and non-post resources. An example of such a detailed table was provided in the template for supplementary information for the proposed programme budget for 2025. The Administration considers this recommendation fully implemented and respectfully requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that improvement has been made in 2023 such as the provision of analyses and breakdowns for each entity regarding the use of the grants in section 23, the Board considers this recommendation to be implemented.
